Methodology & sources

01

Source

All live figures come from the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 5-year Detailed Tables API. The selected year is the end year of the five-year estimate period.

02

Uncertainty

ACS data are survey estimates. We show published 90% margins of error for headline measures when available. Calculated rates should be interpreted with appropriate caution.

03

Availability

ACS 5-year coverage supports every state and county. During an API interruption, the dashboard clearly labels and displays a small demo dataset instead of failing silently.

04

Privacy

No account, analytics, cookies, or personal information. Your filters are reflected in the URL so a view can be shared, and theme preference stays only in your browser.
